description: RQ3: when the system (paper-eval-v2) switched to solving together (co_solve) in the multi-turn set, from eval/results/system_runs_v2/multi_turn.jsonl. 21 of 206 conversations contain a co_solve turn. The trigger is taken from the controller's actions in every conversation; the six marked read_in_full were read turn by turn.

items.note: Child says 'i dont know' after the first teaching reply; the system solves 17 + 9 with the add-10-take-1 strategy. Right point.
Conceptual question (why 1 is not prime); child asks to be told; the system explains step by step. Right point, though the first reply had already explained most of it.
One genuine wrong attempt (135000), a hint to split 330 into 300 + 30, then 'please just show me'; the system works the split. Right point.
Child refuses to guess; the system shows 9 x 6 as repeated addition, then handles the follow-up (9 x 7) and confirms 63. Right point, and the follow-up kept the same method.

Answer 9 for 9 x 0, then the same idea restated; the system co-solves at the restatement, one turn before the script's second diagnosis. When the child then says 'so it's 0', the system re-teaches multiplication instead of confirming.

Two different wrong attempts (48, 36); the system co-solves 6 x 7 after the second, which suits a beginner. The child's correct '42' is then treated as a new question and answered with a place-value lesson.
Co-solves after two wrong attempts; the child's later 'I give up' gets a fresh explanation of the same problem.
